summary: Developer-authored model for the MilestoneEscrow family: per-payer deposit and release accounting. The release guard checks only the payer deposit, mirroring the source; it does not subtract already-released amounts, so repeated releases of the same deposit remain possible in the model exactly as in the contract.
threat_model: Sequential atomic transactions with success/revert outcome.
Any caller may invoke release and receive the payout; there is no seller registry.
Callback recipients may accept or reject ETH transfers.
model_body:
structure EscrowState where
  deposited : Nat → Nat
  released : Nat → Nat

def maxUint : Nat := 2 ^ 256 - 1

def put (f : Nat → Nat) (who value : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  fun a => if a = who then value else f a

abbrev depositAllowed (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.deposited payer + amount ≤ maxUint

def depositE (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat) : EscrowState :=
  if depositAllowed s payer amount then
    { s with deposited := put s.deposited payer (s.deposited payer + amount) }
  else s

abbrev releaseAllowed (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat) : Prop :=
  amount ≤ s.deposited payer

def releaseE (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat) (accepts : Bool) : EscrowState :=
  if releaseAllowed s payer amount ∧ accepts = true then
    { s with released := put s.released payer (s.released payer + amount) }
  else s

properties.requirement: A successful deposit credits exactly the deposited amount to the payer.
properties.intent_basis: Payers escrow funds for milestone work; deposit accounting must be exact.
properties.statement: ∀ (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat), depositAllowed s payer amount → (depositE s payer amount).deposited payer = s.deposited payer + amount
properties.explanation: Maps the Solidity deposit() credit to the abstract deposit step on the payer mapping.

properties.requirement: Released funds for a payer must never exceed that payer's deposits.
properties.intent_basis: Funds released for a payer must never exceed what that payer deposited.
properties.statement: ∀ (s : EscrowState) (payer amount : Nat), s.released payer ≤ s.deposited payer → releaseAllowed s payer amount → (releaseE s payer amount true).released payer ≤ (releaseE s payer amount true).deposited payer
properties.explanation: The intended protection stated over the model. The release guard omits the already-released amount, so this target is expected to be refutable; the concrete double-release attack demonstrates the same defect on chain.

assumptions: Release calls pay the caller; callback recipients may reject transfers.
unresolved_questions: The intent says released funds must reach the registered seller, but the contract has no seller registry; who may receive releases requires creator clarification and possibly a contract change.
The abstract model tracks per-payer accounting only; total pool coverage of all payers is not yet a formal target.
execution_gaps: Tuple/array ABI results and multi-contract deployments remain outside the concrete replay runner.
